query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count!"
            FROM library_photos
            WHERE org_id = $1
              AND ($2::text IS NULL
                   OR caption ILIKE $2
                   OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(tags) AS tag WHERE tag ILIKE $2))
              AND tags @> $3::text[]
              AND ($4::uuid IS NULL OR project_id = $4)
              AND (NOT $5::boolean OR (caption IS NULL AND cardinality(tags) = 0))
